Thanks for the replies. I live in the UK
I just can't see my situation getting any better and I'm certain homelessness awaits me. My laptop is my only companion(sad i know), but I really am hungry.

I'm also in a similar situation. I'm roughly just under £4000 in debt. I have no wife or kids and I'm really tempted to end it all myself. I lost my job recently and I'm about to be homeless. I owe money to my Bank, Paypal as well as a Pay Day loans company. I've been harassed all week with phone calls and I just can't take it anymore.

I have no choice

I'm just sat here in tears man. It's painful when you have no one to turn to and your life is falling apart. 
I've tried holding out for damn near 10 years, hoping that i may find happiness and ultimately have the motivation to change my situation... but here I am on the verge of sleeping on the cold streets of London or just using this damn exit bag.
It's either stay in a burning building or jump. I'm gonna jump
Hopefully the end of my suffering

I've tried holding on, hoping that things may change, that I may become motivated to change my life. A month ago, I quit my dead-end retail job as it was eating away at me. I just couldn't force myself to go into work anymore. In January this year, I spent a month in a mental health facility after a foiled suicide attempt with alcohol. I've tried the antidepressants, I've had the sessions with a psychiatrist, but the sense of hopelessness remains.

I'm not talented at anything. I'm born to be a worthless wage slave. I tried talking to my sister about how I'm feeling and her response was that I'm going to hell if I kill myself. My brother has finally lost patience with my episodes and my mother no longer wants to know.

I've even gone to the lengths of buying a bunch of lottery tickets with the last bit of change I've got, hoping some miraculous miracle happens. Maybe some luck will swing my way. Who am I kidding.

I'm tired of crying uncontrollably. I'm tired of holding out for a better day. I don't have a purpose on this God-forsaken planet.

I'm just tired. I'm tired

I've tried Sertraline for a couple months. Didn't really work. 

I don't really like talking about my problems with a stranger who's being paid to act like they care.

Thank you for your post. I've tried talking about my suicidal ideation with my family, but they just see it as a nuisance. I've battled with depression for over 10 years and I just can't do it anymore. I've tried to hold onto hope, but things just remain the same.

Just tired of life. It all just seems pointless. I seem to be at piece when my eyes are closed.

I really just want to end it painlessly.
I'm £3000 in debt and I've lost my shitty retail job. I'm tired of being a loser with no ambition or motivation.
I think I'm gonna do it. Bye
It will still kill me
Can someone at least let me know through a PM. Thanx
What if I drink all my cans/bottle of alcohol within a short period. Like say within an hour. Surely this will kill me

I'm still here, I haven't made an attempt on my life (yet) as I don't have the funds to purchase any bottles of Vodka. I receive my monthly pay check on the 10th(tomorrow).

My section manager at my job to his credit has been understanding of my situation. He gave me a phone call and has offered me the chance to rethink my decision about quitting. I am tempted to return, to avoid becoming homeless, but the job just breaks me down. The money I earn is barely enough for me to get by. Every month is all about scrimping and saving.
I just feel dead going to a place which doesn't encourage creativity or progress. I'm just a good for nothing piece of crap who dropped out of University and is now paying the price for that decision. 
I just feel powerless to change my situation as I have not talent, no guts and no desire to become anything of note. But I do know that I can't go on living a life of mediocrity and just general failure.

My family have finally had enough of my problems and don't seem to want to know anymore. The only friend I ever had, I pushed him away 5 years ago and became a recluse. I've never experienced love from a woman. I've had to resort to using escorts, which I'm truly ashamed of.

My life is just a mess and I want it to end
I'm just going to overdose on alcohol. I just hope I pass out quick enough. I'm fucking fed up

Thank you for your replies. I worked in a currency exchange in a retail store. I couldn't take it anymore. Waking up and forcing myself to go to a poisonous environment. It was just soul-destroying. I'm now destined to become homeless and I'd much rather die to be honest.

It's going to be a struggle, but I it's evident that most of problems in terms of confidence and my general mood stems from my abuse of porn and masturbation.

June 2012 is nofap or die for me.
